customKeycodes.name: Autoscroll Down
customKeycodes.title: Step autoscroll speed down; stepping through zero stops

customKeycodes.name: OS Cut
customKeycodes.title: Cut — Cmd+X in mac mode, Ctrl+X in pc mode; mode follows USB OS detection unless pinned in Flask

customKeycodes.name: OS Copy
customKeycodes.title: Copy — Cmd+C / Ctrl+C, OS-aware

customKeycodes.name: OS Paste
customKeycodes.title: Paste — Cmd+V / Ctrl+V, OS-aware

customKeycodes.name: OS Undo
customKeycodes.title: Undo — Cmd+Z / Ctrl+Z, OS-aware

customKeycodes.name: OS Redo
customKeycodes.title: Redo — Shift+Cmd+Z in mac mode, Ctrl+Y in pc mode

customKeycodes.name: OS App Switch
customKeycodes.title: App switcher: ⌘Tab in mac mode, Alt-Tab in pc mode (tap = last app)

customKeycodes.name: OS Select All
customKeycodes.title: Select all: ⌘A in mac mode, ^A in pc mode

customKeycodes.name: OS New Tab
customKeycodes.title: New tab: ⌘T in mac mode, ^T in pc mode

customKeycodes.name: OS Close
customKeycodes.title: Close window/tab: ⌘W in mac mode, ^W in pc mode

customKeycodes.name: Num Word
customKeycodes.title: Number layer stays on while typing digits; drops on the first other key or after the idle timeout (Typing tab)
